subject.title: [Bug]: room_event forces message_tool_only despite visibleReplies=automatic, destabilizing prompt cache

question: Should ambient room_event turns use the prompt-stable delivery/tool-inventory policy proposed by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102189 while preserving strict message-tool-only visible delivery?
rationale: The source-level bug is real, but the active fix changes cache-visible owner-only tool inventory and separates prompt-facing mode from effective delivery, which is a maintainer policy choice across session-state, message-delivery, and security-boundary behavior.

options.title: Accept The Candidate Policy
options.body: Review and land the linked PR if ambient room events should keep stable prompt/tool prefixes while actual visible delivery remains message-tool-only.

options.title: Revise Tool Inventory Policy
options.body: Ask the PR to preserve a different owner/non-owner room-event tool inventory and add proof for the resulting cache behavior.

options.title: Close Direction Without Merge
options.body: Reject the policy and close the linked PR and this issue with documentation clarifying that room-event cache churn is an accepted tradeoff.

recommendation.title: Accept The Candidate Policy
recommendation.body: Review and land the linked PR if ambient room events should keep stable prompt/tool prefixes while actual visible delivery remains message-tool-only.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the visible-reply policy history and are the best available owner for accepting or rejecting the room-event delivery contract.
